result.summary: Several visual and content bugs: a broken delivery price (€NaN), a truncated restaurant name, a cut-off category chip, and a promo card that is clipped at the bottom.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. 'Free' or a real amount) and never render NaN.

issues.description: The last restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off by the screen edge with no ellipsis or wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card width and use text overflow (ellipsis) or allow wrapping so the full name remains readable.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right; the last chip is only partially visible with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add padding/peek of the next chip and a fade or scroll indicator so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
